{
  "id": "e09beadb-12ea-48bb-b115-b379ce1cd491",
  "name": "gromacs-protein-md",
  "title": "Protein Molecular Dynamics: Structure and Stability Analysis",
  "description": "GROMACS molecular dynamics simulation of protein systems with comprehensive workflow including solvation, energy minimization, and NPT production runs for protein stability and conformational analysis.",
  "content": "\u003cimg src=\"https://github.com/CamberCloud-Inc/prod_apps/blob/main/gromacs/sim.gif?raw=true\" alt=\"GROMACS Protein MD Simulation\" title=\"\" width=\"309\" height=\"309\"\u003e\u003cp class=\"text-node\"\u003e\u003cbr\u003e\u003cem\u003eProtein molecular dynamics simulation showing solvated protein structure, water molecules, and thermal equilibration\u003c/em\u003e\u003c/p\u003e\u003ch3 class=\"heading-node\"\u003eOverview\u003c/h3\u003e\u003cp class=\"text-node\"\u003eThis application performs comprehensive molecular dynamics simulations of protein systems using \u003ca class=\"link\" href=\"https://www.gromacs.org/\" target=\"_blank\"\u003eGROMACS\u003c/a\u003e (GROningen MAchine for Chemical Simulations). The simulation executes a complete MD workflow from structure preparation through production dynamics.\u003c/p\u003e\u003ch3 class=\"heading-node\"\u003eSimulation Workflow\u003c/h3\u003e\u003cp class=\"text-node\"\u003eThe automated pipeline includes:\u003c/p\u003e\u003cul class=\"list-node\"\u003e\u003cli\u003e\u003cp class=\"text-node\"\u003e\u003cstrong\u003eStructure Preparation\u003c/strong\u003e: Convert PDB to GROMACS format and generate topology\u003c/p\u003e\u003c/li\u003e\u003cli\u003e\u003cp class=\"text-node\"\u003e\u003cstrong\u003eSolvation\u003c/strong\u003e: Add water molecules around the protein in simulation box\u003c/p\u003e\u003c/li\u003e\u003cli\u003e\u003cp class=\"text-node\"\u003e\u003cstrong\u003eEnergy Minimization\u003c/strong\u003e: Optimize geometry using steepest descent algorithm\u003c/p\u003e\u003c/li\u003e\u003cli\u003e\u003cp class=\"text-node\"\u003e\u003cstrong\u003eSalt Addition\u003c/strong\u003e: Add ions to neutralize system and set ionic strength\u003c/p\u003e\u003c/li\u003e\u003cli\u003e\u003cp class=\"text-node\"\u003e\u003cstrong\u003eNVT Equilibration\u003c/strong\u003e: Temperature equilibration at constant volume\u003c/p\u003e\u003c/li\u003e\u003cli\u003e\u003cp class=\"text-node\"\u003e\u003cstrong\u003eNPT Production\u003c/strong\u003e: Production run at constant pressure and temperature\u003c/p\u003e\u003c/li\u003e\u003c/ul\u003e\u003ch3 class=\"heading-node\"\u003ePhysical Parameters\u003c/h3\u003e\u003cp class=\"text-node\"\u003eKey simulation parameters and their effects:\u003c/p\u003e\u003cul class=\"list-node\"\u003e\u003cli\u003e\u003cp class=\"text-node\"\u003e\u003cstrong\u003eTemperature (K)\u003c/strong\u003e: Controls molecular motion and kinetic energy. Physiological ~310K, room temperature ~298K\u003c/p\u003e\u003c/li\u003e\u003cli\u003e\u003cp class=\"text-node\"\u003e\u003cstrong\u003eSalt Concentration (M)\u003c/strong\u003e: Affects electrostatic screening and protein stability. Physiological ~0.15M\u003c/p\u003e\u003c/li\u003e\u003cli\u003e\u003cp class=\"text-node\"\u003e\u003cstrong\u003eSimulation Time (ps)\u003c/strong\u003e: Duration of NPT production run. Longer times provide better sampling\u003c/p\u003e\u003c/li\u003e\u003cli\u003e\u003cp class=\"text-node\"\u003e\u003cstrong\u003ePressure (bar)\u003c/strong\u003e: System pressure for NPT ensemble. Standard atmospheric ~1.0 bar\u003c/p\u003e\u003c/li\u003e\u003cli\u003e\u003cp class=\"text-node\"\u003e\u003cstrong\u003eCutoff Distance (nm)\u003c/strong\u003e: Non-bonded interaction cutoff balancing accuracy vs performance\u003c/p\u003e\u003c/li\u003e\u003cli\u003e\u003cp class=\"text-node\"\u003e\u003cstrong\u003eIntegrator\u003c/strong\u003e: Numerical integration algorithm (leap-frog, velocity-verlet, stochastic dynamics)\u003c/p\u003e\u003c/li\u003e\u003c/ul\u003e\u003ch3 class=\"heading-node\"\u003eExpected Results\u003c/h3\u003e\u003cul class=\"list-node\"\u003e\u003cli\u003e\u003cp class=\"text-node\"\u003eTemperature and pressure equilibration profiles\u003c/p\u003e\u003c/li\u003e\u003cli\u003e\u003cp class=\"text-node\"\u003eDensity evolution during NPT phase\u003c/p\u003e\u003c/li\u003e\u003cli\u003e\u003cp class=\"text-node\"\u003eMolecular trajectory for structural analysis\u003c/p\u003e\u003c/li\u003e\u003cli\u003e\u003cp class=\"text-node\"\u003eEnergy profiles throughout simulation\u003c/p\u003e\u003c/li\u003e\u003cli\u003e\u003cp class=\"text-node\"\u003eRMSD and conformational sampling data\u003c/p\u003e\u003c/li\u003e\u003c/ul\u003e\u003ch3 class=\"heading-node\"\u003eScientific Relevance\u003c/h3\u003e\u003cp class=\"text-node\"\u003eProtein molecular dynamics simulations are essential for understanding how environmental conditions affect protein stability and function, providing critical insights for drug design and biotechnology applications. These simulations reveal atomic-level details of protein-solvent interactions that are impossible to observe experimentally, making them invaluable for predicting protein behavior under physiological and extreme conditions.\u003c/p\u003e\u003ch3 class=\"heading-node\"\u003eVisualization\u003c/h3\u003e\u003cp class=\"text-node\"\u003eAfter simulation completion, open \u003ccode class=\"inline\" spellcheck=\"false\"\u003egromacs.ipynb\u003c/code\u003e in JupyterHub on Camber and execute all cells to generate interactive 3D visualization showing protein structure, water solvation, and thermal dynamics evolution.\u003c/p\u003e\u003ch3 class=\"heading-node\"\u003eProject Structure\u003c/h3\u003e\u003cpre class=\"block-node\"\u003e\u003ccode\u003egromacs/\n├── run_gromacs.sh           # Main simulation runner with parameters\n├── 1cta.pdb                 # Initial protein structure (Protein Data Bank)\n├── topol.top                # Molecular topology and force field\n├── output/\n│   ├── npt.tpr              # Final structure file with topology\n│   ├── npt_nopbc.xtc        # NPT trajectory (periodic boundaries removed)\n│   ├── nvt_temperature.xvg  # Temperature equilibration profile\n│   ├── npt_pressure.xvg     # Pressure equilibration profile\n│   └── npt_density.xvg      # Density evolution data\n└── gromacs.ipynb            # Interactive visualization notebook\u003c/code\u003e\u003c/pre\u003e",
  "version": "1.0.0",
